name: OpenBrain v1.0
alternateName: OpenBrain: Confidence-Tiered Brain MRI Pseudo-Label Release v1.0
description: OpenBrain v1.0 is a confidence-aware whole-brain MRI parcellation release. It contains 35,838 brain-extracted T1-weighted MRI cases drawn from 607 OpenNeuro source datasets that carry CC0/public-domain-compatible license metadata. Each case ships (i) a SynthStrip brain mask, (ii) an automated whole-brain segmentation produced by the canonical M1 segmenter, (iii) seven raw reference-free QC values (Q1 brain leakage, Q2 volume outliers, Q3 distant components, Q4 intensity CV, Q5 committee Dice, Q6 voxel entropy, Q7 volume CV), (iv) seven within-source percentile risks (r1..r7), (v) the combined risk R = mean(r1..r7), and (vi) a confidence tier (HighConf / Standard / Flagged) at K=25%/75% cuts on R. Labels are AI-generated; the release does not claim manual ground-truth quality. Users can filter, weight, audit, or re-threshold cases using the released QC manifest without rerunning inference.
citeAs: @inproceedings{openbrain2026, author = {Anonymous}, title = {OpenBrain: A Large-Scale, Multi-Source, & Confidence-Tiered Brain MRI Pseudo-Label Release for Population-Scale Parcellation and Reference-Free Quality Control}, booktitle = {Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems Evaluations & Datasets Track}, year = {2026}}
rai:dataLimitations: Pseudo-labels are AI-generated by the M1 ResEnc U-Net segmenter; they are not manual ground-truth and should not be used for individual clinical diagnosis.
M1 inherits FreeSurfer 7.4.1 atlas conventions; users following alternative atlases (e.g., DKT-only, AAL, JHU) may observe boundary differences not captured by Core-7.
Core-7 QC is reference-free and source-local; it does not provide an absolute manual-label-anchored quality score.
Demographic metadata coverage is incomplete: age 62.8%, sex 71.5%, manufacturer 73.1%, magnetic-field-strength 69.5%, health-status 27.6%; missing values are not imputed.
Mindboggle-101 (n=101) is the only manual-label external cohort referenced in our paper; it is held out as a confirmatory holdout and is not redistributed as part of this release.
OpenBrain v1.0 is a conservative-license subset of a larger 42,732-case provenance pool; non-CC0 sources were excluded and are documented in metadata/excluded_cases_summary.csv.
rai:dataBiases: Source skew: the largest single OpenNeuro source contributes 7.2% of cases; the top-3 sources together contribute 15.1% and the top-10 contribute 26.4%.
Field strength is dominated by 3T scanners (~86% of cases with reported field strength). 1.5T (~6%) and 7T (~2%) are present but underrepresented.
Manufacturer skew: Siemens scanners produce ~69% of cases with reported manufacturer; Philips ~19%; GE ~12%.
Age coverage is skewed young (median 24 years on the 63% of cases with reported age); pediatric (<18) and elderly (>65) subpopulations are present but underrepresented.
Health-status coverage is only 28%; healthy/clinical stratification cannot be performed for the majority of cases. Subgroup analyses by health status should account for this.

Source-dataset ascertainment biases (sampling protocols, scanner choices, eligibility criteria) propagate from OpenNeuro to OpenBrain and are documented at the per-source level via dataset_doi and openneuro_dataset_name.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: All released images are skull-stripped (SynthStrip) and intensity-normalized; brain extraction reduces but does not eliminate facial-feature reconstruction risk.
Subject identifiers in the release are BIDS-derived and source-scoped (case_id encodes source_dataset + subject + session); no cross-source identity linkage is provided.
All cases derive from OpenNeuro snapshots verified to carry CC0 / public-domain-compatible license metadata; per-source license records are in metadata/openneuro_dataset_audit.csv.

Cases with manual-review license status, ambiguous raw BIDS matches, missing OpenNeuro provenance, or missing raw T1w matches were excluded; see metadata/excluded_cases_summary.csv for the audit trail.
rai:dataUseCases: Population-scale brain MRI parcellation training: train a downstream segmenter on a user-chosen confidence subset (HighConf, full release, or any custom threshold on R).
Confidence-aware learning research: noisy-label, curriculum, and loss-reweighting methods can consume the per-case Core-7 risks r1..r7 directly.

QC method development: the seven raw axes Q1..Q7, percentile risks r1..r7, and committee predictions are released so users can build alternative panels, recompose tiers, or evaluate QC under domain shift.
Cross-cohort generalization studies: 607 OpenNeuro source datasets enable source-stratified train/test splits for systematic out-of-distribution evaluation.
Demographic auditing of segmentation pipelines: the metadata join supports per-stratum analyses on the covered subset (with explicit acknowledgement of incomplete coverage).
rai:dataSocialImpact: Intended use: research on brain MRI quality control, confidence-aware learning, and population-scale parcellation method development.

Discouraged use: clinical decision making, individual-patient diagnosis, and demographic-group medical inference. The released labels are pseudo-labels with explicit reliability information, not clinical-grade outputs.
Researchers analyzing demographic subgroups should account for the ~25-30% missing-metadata rate and the source-skew biases documented above; subgroup conclusions are limited to the covered subset.
Releasing per-case confidence information allows users to detect, filter, or re-weight low-quality cases at use time, reducing the risk of silently propagating label errors into downstream models.

prov:wasDerivedFrom.name: OpenNeuro
prov:wasDerivedFrom.description: Source repository of T1-weighted brain MRI used in OpenBrain. OpenBrain v1.0 includes only OpenNeuro snapshots verified to carry CC0/public-domain-compatible license metadata; per-source DOI and snapshot tags are in metadata/openneuro_dataset_audit.csv.
prov:wasDerivedFrom.citation: Markiewicz CJ, et al. The OpenNeuro resource for sharing of neuroscience data. eLife 10:e71774 (2021). https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.71774

prov:wasDerivedFrom.name: OpenMind
prov:wasDerivedFrom.description: Self-supervised brain-MRI corpus used as the curated entry point into OpenNeuro for OpenBrain.
prov:wasDerivedFrom.citation: Wald T, et al. An OpenMind for 3D Medical Vision Self-Supervised Learning. arXiv:2412.17041 (2024).

prov:wasGeneratedBy: OpenBrain release pipeline: (1) source aggregation from OpenNeuro through OpenMind with CC0/public-domain license filtering; (2) preprocessing with SynthStrip skull-stripping, intensity normalization, and spatial resampling; (3) committee inference with three architecturally distinct segmenters (M1 3D ResEnc U-Net, M2 SwinUNETR, M3 UNETR), all trained on FreeSurfer-7.4.1-aligned references; (4) reference-free Core-7 QC scoring on seven axes (Q1-Q7) with within-source percentile-risk normalization; (5) tier assignment at K=25%/75% cuts on combined risk R = mean(r1..r7).

distribution.name: openbrain_v1_0_metadata.csv
distribution.description: Per-case core metadata: BIDS identifiers, source dataset DOI/snapshot, demographic fields (age, sex, race, handedness, weight, BMI), scanner fields (manufacturer, model, field strength, repetition time, echo time, phase encoding direction), and release-path fields. Coverage of demographic and scanner fields varies; see rai:dataBiases.

distribution.name: openbrain_v1_0_qc_manifest.csv
distribution.description: Per-case Core-7 QC manifest: case_id, source_dataset, raw QC values Q1..Q7, within-source percentile risks r1..r7, combined risk R, and confidence tier (HighConf/Standard/Flagged). Tier counts in v1.0: HighConf 8,960 (25.0%) / Standard 17,918 (50.0%) / Flagged 8,960 (25.0%).

distribution.name: label_map_whole_brain_segmentation.json
distribution.description: Mapping from OpenBrain internal segmentation label IDs (1..110) to anatomical names (FreeSurfer-aligned). Note: OpenBrain internal label IDs are NOT identical to FreeSurfer aseg IDs; resolve by name match.

distribution.name: openneuro_dataset_audit.csv
distribution.description: Per-OpenNeuro-source provenance audit: dataset name, snapshot tag, DOI, license, and case count contributed.

distribution.name: openneuro_case_path_audit.csv
distribution.description: Per-case path audit: matched BIDS path within the OpenNeuro snapshot, original raw T1w image path, derived release paths.

distribution.name: excluded_cases_summary.csv
distribution.description: Audit trail of cases excluded between the 42,732-case provenance pool and the 35,838-case CC0 release: per-case drop reason (license, OpenNeuro provenance missing, ambiguous BIDS match, raw T1w match missing, or manual review).

distribution.name: sha256_manifest.csv
distribution.description: SHA-256 hashes of every released artifact: image.nii.gz, brain_mask.nii.gz, whole_brain_segmentation.nii.gz per case.

distribution.name: case_files_image
distribution.description: Per-case T1-weighted preprocessed image (skull-stripped, intensity-normalized, spatially resampled).

distribution.name: case_files_segmentation
distribution.description: Per-case 110-class whole-brain pseudo-parcellation produced by M1 (canonical pseudo-label).

recordSet.name: cases
recordSet.description: One record per released case. Joins core metadata + Core-7 QC manifest on case_id.

field.name: case_id
field.description: Source-scoped BIDS subject/session identifier (e.g., 'ds000001__sub-01__ses-01__sub-01_ses-01_T1w'). Unique within v1.0.

field.name: source_dataset
field.description: OpenNeuro source dataset accession (e.g., 'ds000001').

field.name: dataset_doi
field.description: DOI of the OpenNeuro source dataset, where available.

field.name: dataset_license
field.description: License of the OpenNeuro source. v1.0 retains only CC0 / public-domain-compatible licenses.

field.name: age
field.description: Subject age in years (62.8% coverage; missing values are NaN, not imputed).

field.name: sex
field.description: Subject sex (71.5% coverage; values: 'female', 'male'; missing as NaN).

field.name: health_status
field.description: Health status (28% coverage; values: 'healthy', 'ill').

field.name: manufacturer
field.description: Scanner manufacturer (73.1% coverage; values: 'siemens', 'philips', 'ge', other).

field.name: magnetic_field_strength
field.description: Magnetic field strength in Tesla (69.5% coverage; e.g., 1.5, 3.0, 7.0).

field.name: Q1_brain_leakage
field.description: Raw Q1 brain leakage value: fraction of foreground label voxels outside the brain mask. Lower is better.

field.name: Q2_volume_outliers
field.description: Raw Q2 volume-outlier count: number of labels with per-source Tukey-IQR-fenced volumes outside the source distribution. Lower is better.

field.name: Q3_distant_components
field.description: Raw Q3 distant-components score: fraction of foreground voxels in disconnected components far from each label's primary component. Lower is better.

field.name: Q4_intensity_cv
field.description: Raw Q4 image-label intensity coefficient of variation: median ROI-level coefficient of variation of T1w intensity. Lower is better.

field.name: Q5_committee_dice
field.description: Raw Q5 committee pairwise Dice: mean per-label Dice averaged over the three committee pairs. Higher is better.

field.name: Q6_voxel_entropy
field.description: Raw Q6 voxel-vote entropy: mean Shannon entropy of voxel-wise three-model votes within foreground. Lower is better.

field.name: Q7_volume_cv
field.description: Raw Q7 committee volume coefficient of variation: per-label CV of the three committee predictions' volumes, then averaged across labels. Lower is better.

field.name: r1
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q1 (range [0,1]; higher = riskier within the source dataset).

field.name: r2
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q2.

field.name: r3
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q3.

field.name: r4
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q4.

field.name: r5
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q5 (sign-flipped: higher Q5 -> lower r5).

field.name: r6
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q6.

field.name: r7
field.description: Within-source percentile risk derived from Q7.

field.name: R
field.description: Combined risk: equal-weighted mean of r1..r7. Range [0,1]; higher = riskier.

field.name: tier
field.description: Confidence tier at K=25%/75% cuts on R within v1.0. Values: 'HighConf' (lowest 25% of R), 'Standard' (middle 50%), 'Flagged' (highest 25%). v1.0 counts: HighConf 8,960; Standard 17,918; Flagged 8,960.

field.name: image
field.description: T1-weighted preprocessed image (NIfTI).

field.name: brain_mask
field.description: SynthStrip-derived brain mask (NIfTI, binary).

field.name: whole_brain_segmentation
field.description: M1 whole-brain pseudo-parcellation (NIfTI, integer label map; 1..110 plus background 0).
